race.comment: NEW PROSPECT (3) is the runner to beat after finding a more suitable setup than the Class 1 at Dalby, where he raced wide throughout and was beaten just over eight lengths at big odds. His start prior was decisive, winning a Mdn at Gympie and the drop back from provincial grade to this easier country assignment gives him a strong platform. DESTINY GUNGHO (6) is a genuine danger after going under by just over half a length in a BM50 at Taroom and he brings the best track-and-distance credentials, with one win and two placings from four attempts at this track and trip. FRIDAY'S JET (12) is an older gelding but was only beaten half a length first-up at Kumbia and has the distance record to keep pressing forward in this grade. GUNNA REIGN (9) was plain in a BM60 on the Gold Coast Poly, yet her Stanthorpe second the start prior and the easier country assignment give her a realistic place profile if she rebounds.
